item.title: Demon Slayer: The Hinokami Chronicles 2 Adds Infinity Castle Shinobu on April 17
item.description: Sega and Aniplex have confirmed that Shinobu Kocho (Infinity Castle Version) will join the Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles 2 character roster on Friday, April 17, 2026.
